rules.text: Most items purchased directly from the HP Store can be returned within 30 days from the date of delivery of your order.
rules.quote: For all eligible purchases, our return policy is 30 days from the date of delivery of your order.

rules.text: Items from the HP Parts Store, Instant Ink, All-In Plan, retailers, HP Technical Support, software, services, or repair orders are not returnable.
rules.quote: We cannot accept returns or exchanges for items from the HP Parts Store, Instant Ink, All-In Plan, retailers, or HP Technical Support, including software, services, or repair orders.

rules.text: Gift cards are not returnable except where required by law.
rules.quote: Gift Cards (except where required by law)

rules.text: Large format printers are not returnable unless defective or due to HP Store error.
rules.quote: Large format printers (for example, DesignJet’s) are not returnable unless the product is defective or the return is a result of an HP Store error

rules.text: Refunds are issued only to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: Refunds can only be issued back to your original form of payment.

rules.text: Refunds take up to 5 business days to validate and up to 5 additional business days to appear depending on bank processing.
rules.quote: Please allow up to 5 business days for our team to validate your return. From there, the refund will be processed and you will receive email confirmation. The refund may then take up to 5 business days to appear on your account, depending on your bank’s processing time.

rules.text: Original shipping charges are non-refundable for convenience returns.
rules.quote: In instances of a return for convenience (eg, no longer need, changed your mind), original shipping charges are non-refundable.

rules.text: HP requires the original product to be returned before a replacement is shipped.
rules.quote: HP Store requires the original product to be returned before a replacement is shipped.

rules.text: Claims regarding delivery issues must be made within 10 days of delivery or last tracking scan.
rules.quote: All claims regarding delivery issues, including loss, damage, mis-delivery, etc., must be made within 10 days of delivery or of the last package tracking scan.

rules.text: Returns must be made in the same country as the purchase was made.
rules.quote: All returns must be made in the same country in which the purchase was made.
